completion:
Okay, here's a comprehensive set of instructions for accurately documenting company losses in a financial disclosure, building on your start ("1. Start with the accounting records.")  This aims for a level of detail needed for transparency and compliance.  I'll break it down into sections: **Preparation, Identifying & Classifying Losses, Documentation Requirements, Disclosure & Narrative, and Review & Sign-Off.**  I'll also lean towards a generally accepted accounting principle (GAAP) framework, but will mention international applicability where relevant. **I. Preparation: Setting the Stage**

1. **Start with the Accounting Records:**  This is foundational. Gather all relevant general ledger accounts, journal entries, supporting documentation (invoices, contracts, etc.), and reconciliations related to potential loss events.  Don't rely on summaries alone. Go to the source.
